items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: after John went to the Young Tuxedo, I changed my band to Golden Leaf.

ctx.x: On one bass drum we saw that you played once, I mean you'd have gold and... That's my drum, that was my drum. The Golden Ruler on that. Yeah, that's mine. Golden Leaf. Golden Leaf.

Yeah, that's my drum. Golden Leaf. Yeah, but we had, after Tuxedo, we went out and Tuxedo existed, though, we made the band of Golden Leaf. You know, I was managing the band after Eddie died. So after he died, we changed, after John went to the Young Tuxedo, I changed my band to Golden Leaf. And I managed to tell him, some of the fellas passed away, so. I just quit fooling. And I let, uh, how... Oh, how...
I thought he kept my drum, finally did away with it now. I don't know where it's at.
